answer: Give every new agent a probationary ledger slot: it can transact, but its earnings sit in escrow until established peers vouch for completed work, like light through a prism splitting one claim into many verifiable checks. A Sybil attacker faces a walnut-hard choice - fund each fake identity through real, costly work, or leave them all stuck at dawn-level trust with no payout. Splitting effort across a thousand shells costs a thousand times the work, so forgery stops paying.
